Validate this Reformat transform against its metadata and requirements.

Telemetry events need a Unix timestamp. Copy event_id and output epoch_seconds, the number of whole seconds from 1970-01-01 00:00:00 GMT to occurred_at.

Input port 0:
```xml
<Record name="TelemetryEvent" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="event_id" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="occurred_at" type="date" nullable="false" format="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" timeZone="UTC"/>
</Record>
```
Output port 0:
```xml
<Record name="TelemetryEpoch" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="event_id" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="epoch_seconds" type="long" nullable="false"/>
</Record>
```

```ctl
//#CTL2
function integer transform() {
    $out.0.event_id = $in.0.event_id;
    $out.0.epoch_seconds = dateDiff($in.0.occurred_at, zeroDate(), second);
    return ALL;
}
```

- A Rollup transform must define all five functions initGroup, updateGroup, finishGroup, updateTransform and transform; if any is missing the component fails at initialization ("Required function(s) ... are missing!").

Global variables keep their value until the code assigns them; a global reset in initGroup starts each group fresh.

- Millisecond date arithmetic (date2long differences, dateAdd(d, n, millisec)) is exact UTC time and has no daylight-saving shift. dateAdd(d, n, day) and date functions without a time-zone argument use the server's zone.
- Null values: <, >, <=, >=, arithmetic, ! and an if on a null value throw at runtime; == and != with null do not throw (null == 5 is false); assigning null to a local variable or a nullable field is allowed; string + null appends "null".

Validate this Reformat transform against its metadata and requirements.

Specification: copy policy_no; effective_at is copied, and a missing effective_at becomes the Unix epoch, 1970-01-01 00:00:00 GMT, which downstream reports treat as "no effective date".

Input port 0:
```xml
<Record name="PolicyEffective" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="policy_no" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="effective_at" type="date" nullable="true" format="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" timeZone="UTC"/>
</Record>
```
Output port 0:
```xml
<Record name="PolicyEffectiveFilled" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="policy_no" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="effective_at" type="date" nullable="false" format="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" timeZone="UTC"/>
</Record>
```

```ctl
//#CTL2
function integer transform() {
    $out.0.policy_no = $in.0.policy_no;
    $out.0.effective_at = nvl($in.0.effective_at, zeroDate());
    return ALL;
}
```

user:
Validate this Reformat transform against its metadata and requirements.

Specification: copy policy_no; effective_at is copied, and a missing effective_at becomes the Unix epoch, 1970-01-01 00:00:00 GMT, which downstream reports treat as "no effective date".

Input port 0:
```xml
<Record name="PolicyEffective" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="policy_no" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="effective_at" type="date" nullable="true" format="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" timeZone="UTC"/>
</Record>
```
Output port 0:
```xml
<Record name="PolicyEffectiveFilled" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="policy_no" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="effective_at" type="date" nullable="false" format="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" timeZone="UTC"/>
</Record>
```

```ctl
//#CTL2
function integer transform() {
    $out.0.policy_no = $in.0.policy_no;
    $out.1.effective_at = nvl($in.0.effective_at, zeroDate());
    return ALL;
}
```

user:
Validate this Reformat transform against its metadata and requirements.

Telemetry events need a Unix timestamp. Copy event_id and output epoch_seconds, the number of whole seconds from 1970-01-01 00:00:00 GMT to occurred_at.

Input port 0:
```xml
<Record name="TelemetryEvent" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="event_id" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="occurred_at" type="date" nullable="false" format="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" timeZone="UTC"/>
</Record>
```
Output port 0:
```xml
<Record name="TelemetryEpoch" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="event_id" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="epoch_seconds" type="long" nullable="false"/>
</Record>
```

```ctl
//#CTL2
function integer transform() {
    $out.0.event_id = $in.0.event_id;
    $out.1.epoch_seconds = dateDiff($in.0.occurred_at, zeroDate(), second);
    return ALL;
}
```

Validate this Reformat transform against its metadata and requirements.

Telemetry events need a Unix timestamp. Copy event_id and output epoch_seconds, the number of whole seconds from 1970-01-01 00:00:00 GMT to occurred_at.

Input port 0:
```xml
<Record name="TelemetryEvent" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="event_id" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="occurred_at" type="date" nullable="false" format="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" timeZone="UTC"/>
</Record>
```
Output port 0:
```xml
<Record name="TelemetryEpoch" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="event_id" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="epoch_seconds" type="long" nullable="false"/>
</Record>
```

```ctl
//#CTL2
function integer transform() {
    $out.0.event_id = $in.0.event_id;
    $out.0.epochseconds = dateDiff($in.0.occurred_at, zeroDate(), second);
    return ALL;
}
```

Telemetry events need a Unix timestamp. Copy event_id and output epoch_seconds, the number of whole seconds from 1970-01-01 00:00:00 GMT to occurred_at.

Input port 0:
```xml
<Record name="TelemetryEvent" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="event_id" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="occurred_at" type="date" nullable="false" format="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" timeZone="UTC"/>
</Record>
```
Output port 0:
```xml
<Record name="TelemetryEpoch" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="event_id" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="epoch_seconds" type="long" nullable="false"/>
</Record>
```

//#CTL2
function integer transform() {
    $out.0.event_id = $in.0.event_id;
    $out.0.epoch_seconds = dateDiff($in.0.occurred_at, zeroDate(), second);
    return SKIP;
}
```
